evidence.quote: Free Care: The gross (undiscounted) charge amount for eligible services will be waived for applicants whose total Income is at or below 200% of the current federal poverty level, shown on Appendix A.

tiers.description: 75% discount for 201%-300% FPL per Appendix A location table
65% discount for 301%-400% FPL per Appendix A location table

asset_test.details: Income documentation may include checking, savings and investment account statements, and applicants must use available funds in tax-advantaged health accounts (FSA/HSA); no explicit asset test stated.

evidence.quote: Qualified Account review: Applicants with tax-advantaged personal health accounts such as flexible spending accounts or health savings accounts will be expected to utilize available funds upon being granted financial assistance.

residency.area: State of Wisconsin and the Upper Peninsula of Michigan (MCHS service area); emergency care eligible regardless of residence

evidence.quote: For non- emergent medically necessary services, financial assistance eligibility is based on the patient’s primary residence in relation to the MCHS service area and the nature of the care required.
MCHS will accept a financial assistance application for at least 240 days following the patient/guarantor’s first billing statement or as deemed reasonable.

presumptive_eligibility: Applicants may be presumed eligible for free care (100% discount) without an application based on socio-economic factors such as means-tested program eligibility or homelessness.
how_to_apply: Mail or hand-deliver to Marshfield Clinic Health System Patient Financial Assistance Center, 3Q4 1000 North Oak Avenue Marshfield, WI 54449; 1-800-782-8581, ext. 94475; https://marshfieldclinic.org/patient-resources/billing/financial-assistance
warnings: Catastrophic cap: 100% discount on guarantor balances exceeding 10% of income when FPL is at or below 600%.
Section 3.5 describes a sliding scale for 200%-400%; the Appendix A table gives 75% (201-300%) and 65% (301-400%).
Appendix A table header reads 'Less than or equal to 100-200%' for the free care band.
Residency rules for non-emergency care are discretionary; the 240 days is a minimum ('at least').
Many non-MCHS provider groups are not covered by this policy (Appendix C).
Asset test not explicitly addressed; applicants may be asked for account statements as income documentation.
